approval.title: APPROVED — PHASE 4 ISOLATED COMMON EGG FUNCTIONAL TEST EXCEPTION
approval.source: Direct human owner message in the current Codex conversation; no attachment.
approval.quote: I approve implementation of the EXACT reviewed patch: `docs/PHASE4-FUNCTIONAL-HATCH-EXCEPTION-PROPOSED.patch`
approval.scope: Only the exact reviewed three-file patch: OCConfig, PetPolicy and the single OCBrain PlanPets economic condition. One explicitly authorized account, Common Egg in The Overworld, count=1, at most 10 Coins, solely functional receipt verification.
approval.exclusions: No movement, EggTravelManager, GameKnowledge, Prepare, HatchManager, allowance ledger, native transport or other protected-method change. No paid activation, hatch request, equipment or spending authorization.

diff --git a/src/OCFoundation/OCConfig.luau b/src/OCFoundation/OCConfig.luau
--- a/src/OCFoundation/OCConfig.luau
+++ b/src/OCFoundation/OCConfig.luau
@@ -235,6 +235,7 @@
 		SELECTION_REVISION = 0, --// Increment explicitly to authorize a new attempt at the same egg after manual movement or failure.
 	},
 	OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_SETTINGS = {
+		OWNER_ONE_COMMON_EGG_FUNCTIONAL_TEST = false, --// Separate owner-approved one-request Common Egg receipt test; never ordinary economic permission.
 		OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_ALLOWANCE = false, --// Separate explicit owner opt-in for ONE manual Coins hatch using capped currently earmarked world funds; ordinary AUTO never enables it.
 		AUTHORIZED_ACCOUNT_ID = 0, --// Explicit owner-approved Roblox UserId; zero blocks an enabled allowance. Never derive authorization from the current account automatically.
 		MAXIMUM_COIN_ALLOWANCE = 0, --// Cap the exceptional draw from currently held world-goal Coins; configured resource reserves and the native world goal remain unchanged.

+++ b/src/OCFoundation/PetPolicy.luau
@@ -378,6 +378,35 @@

 	return r
+end

+-- A separate explicit functional-test scope, never a changed economic estimate.
+-- Ordinary/access evidence remains the existing GameKnowledge Accessible field;
+-- exact Instance registration/nearest/arrival and final paid guards remain mandatory.
+function PetPolicy.OwnerCommonEggFunctionalTestEligible(config, context, egg)
+	local settings, h = config.OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_SETTINGS, config.HATCH_SETTINGS
+	if not settings or settings.OWNER_ONE_COMMON_EGG_FUNCTIONAL_TEST ~= true
+		or settings.OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_ALLOWANCE ~= true then return false end
+	local id = context and context.AccountId
+	if not PetPolicy.Finite(id) or id <= 0 or id % 1 ~= 0 or id ~= settings.AUTHORIZED_ACCOUNT_ID then return false end
+	if OwnerHatchTestAllowance.Isolation(config) then return false end
+	for _, ceiling in ipairs({ settings.MAXIMUM_COIN_ALLOWANCE, settings.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST,
+		h.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST, h.MAXIMUM_SESSION_COST }) do
+		if not PetPolicy.Finite(ceiling) or ceiling <= 0 or ceiling > 10 then return false end
+	end
+	return egg.Name == "Common Egg" and egg.World == "The Overworld" and egg.Loaded == true and egg.Eligible == true
+		and h.EGG_SELECTION_MODE == "MANUAL" and #h.SELECTED_EGGS == 1 and h.SELECTED_EGGS[1] == "Common Egg"
+		and h.HATCH_ONE_EGG_ONCE == true and h.MAXIMUM_SESSION_HATCHES == 1 and h.MAXIMUM_BATCH_HATCHES == 1
+		and egg.Cost and egg.Cost.Type == "Currency" and egg.Cost.Currency == "Coins"
+		and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.Cost.Amount) and egg.Cost.Amount > 0 and egg.Cost.Amount <= 10
+		and egg.OwnerTestAllowance and egg.OwnerTestAllowance.Eligible == true
+		and egg.Status == "ESTIMATE" and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.ExpectedIncrement)
+		and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.BaselineScore) and type(egg.BaselineIds) == "table"
+		and egg.BaselineIncomplete == false and egg.BaselineSearchBoundReached == false and egg.BaselineProjectionFailures == 0
+		and type(egg.Outcomes) == "table" and #egg.Outcomes > 0
+		and egg.FundingStatus == "AFFORDABLE" and egg.SpendingStatus == "AUTHORIZED_CONFIG"
+		and egg.CapacityStatus == "AVAILABLE" and egg.EffectiveBatchCapacity == 1
+		and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.DurationSeconds) and egg.DurationSeconds > 0 or false
 end

methods.beforeMethodText:
function PetPolicy.Egg(config, snapshot, context, team, egg)
	local h = config.HATCH_SETTINGS
	local r = { Name = egg.Name, Status = "UNKNOWN", Eligible = egg.Accessible == true, InRange = egg.InRange == true,
		Loaded = egg.Loaded, AccessStatus = egg.AccessStatus or "UNKNOWN_ACCESS", World = egg.World, Island = egg.Island,
		Distance = egg.Distance, Range = egg.Range, ModelPath = egg.ModelPath, Position = egg.Position,
		Cost = egg.Cost, Reason = egg.Reason, ProbabilityEvidence = "CLIENT_POOL_WEIGHT_ESTIMATE; conditional normalized native sampler model",
		EffectiveServerOdds = "UNKNOWN", VariantOdds = "UNKNOWN", PityGuarantee = "UNKNOWN", TotalTimeSeconds = "UNKNOWN",
		TravelTimeSeconds = "UNKNOWN", VerificationTimeSeconds = "UNKNOWN", StorageUnit = context.StorageUnit,
		DurationSeconds = egg.Duration, NativeBatchCapacity = context.MaxHatches, Outcomes = {},
		SelectionMode = PetPolicy.SelectionMode(config), OrdinaryLuck = egg.Luck,
		SecretLuck = "UNKNOWN_EFFECTIVE", InfinityLuck = "UNKNOWN_EFFECTIVE", BatchExpectedIncrement = "UNKNOWN",
		BatchEvidence = "Single outcome marginal only; duplicate saturation/interacting teams prevent linear batch utility; replan from actual received inventory" }
	PetPolicy.FundEgg(config, snapshot, r, context.AccountId)
	local cost = egg.Cost
	-- Funding/configuration/access are separate from the supported pool estimate.
	if egg.Loaded == false then r.Reason = egg.Reason return r end
	if not cost or cost.Type ~= "Currency" or not PetPolicy.Finite(cost.Amount) or cost.Amount <= 0 then r.Reason = "Native currency cost unavailable/unsupported" return r end
	if team.Status ~= "ESTIMATE" or not context.ScoreNewPet or type(egg.Pool) ~= "table"
		or type(team.ProposedIds) ~= "table" or not PetPolicy.Finite(team.ProjectedScore) then r.Reason = "Insufficient native owned-team/pool evidence" return r end
	-- Keep the received equipped score for disclosure, but benchmark a purchase
	-- against the strongest feasible owned lineup found by the existing search.
	-- Proposed IDs obey quantities/protections/Super preservation; this is an
	-- analysis projection and never equipment authorization or a global optimum.
	r.BaselineIds, r.BaselineScore = table.clone(team.ProposedIds), team.ProjectedScore
	r.CurrentEquippedScore, r.OwnedImprovementAvailable = team.CurrentScore, team.Gain
	r.BaselineEvidence = "BOUNDED_FEASIBLE_OWNED_TEAM; native full-team estimate, global optimum UNKNOWN"
	r.BaselineSearchBoundReached = team.SearchBoundReached
	r.BaselineIncomplete, r.BaselineStatus = team.BaselineIncomplete, team.BaselineStatus
	r.BaselineProjectionFailures = (team.ProjectionFailures or 0) + (team.OwnedCandidateFailures or 0)
	r.OutcomeProjectionEvidence = "One base XP0 acquisition, best supported single replacement/addition from the owned benchmark; unseen coupled combinations UNKNOWN"
	local total, poolLength = 0, 0
	for index in pairs(egg.Pool) do
		if type(index) ~= "number" or index < 1 or index % 1 ~= 0 then r.Reason = "Unknown non-array native pool" return r end
		poolLength += 1
	end
	for index = 1, poolLength do if egg.Pool[index] == nil then r.Reason = "Incomplete native pool array" return r end end
	for _, entry in ipairs(egg.Pool) do
		if type(entry) ~= "table" or not PetPolicy.Finite(entry.Chance) then r.Reason = "Unknown pool weight" return r end
		total += entry.Chance
	end
	if not PetPolicy.Finite(total) or total <= 0 then r.Reason = "Empty or invalid native pool weight total" return r end
	r.PoolTotalWeight = total
	local expected, improveChance, targetChance = 0, 0, 0
	local projections = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(egg.Pool) do
		local item = entry.Item
		if entry.Chance == 0 then continue end
		if type(item) ~= "table" or item.Type ~= "Pet" or type(item.Name) ~= "string" or not (context.Pets or {})[item.Name] then r.Reason = "Unsupported pool outcome" return r end
		local value = projections[item.Name]
		if value == nil then value = context.ScoreNewPet(item.Name, r.BaselineIds) projections[item.Name] = value end
		if not PetPolicy.Finite(value) then r.Reason = "Native pet contribution unavailable" return r end
		local probability = entry.Chance / total -- Inspected native weighted sampler; NOT verified server RNG.
		local gain = math.max(0, value - r.BaselineScore)
		expected += gain * probability
		if gain > 1e-6 then improveChance += probability end
		if table.find(config.PET_SETTINGS.SELECTED_PETS, item.Name) then targetChance += probability end
		table.insert(r.Outcomes, { Name = item.Name, ClientPoolProbability = probability, IncrementalGain = gain,
			ProjectedScore = value, BaselineScore = r.BaselineScore })
	end
	if not PetPolicy.Finite(expected) then r.Reason = "Invalid expected native contribution" return r end
	r.Status, r.ExpectedIncrement, r.ClientImprovementProbability, r.ClientTargetProbability = "ESTIMATE", expected, improveChance, targetChance
	r.ExpectedIncrementPerCost = expected / cost.Amount
	local capacity = PetPolicy.Finite(context.MaxHatches) and context.MaxHatches >= 1 and context.MaxHatches % 1 == 0 and context.MaxHatches or 0
	local free = PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageCapacity) and PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageUsed) and math.max(0, math.floor(context.StorageCapacity - context.StorageUsed)) or 0
	r.CapacityStatus = type(context.DigitalStorage) ~= "boolean" and "UNKNOWN_STORAGE_MODE"
		or context.InventoryFull ~= false and "CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE_OR_FULL"
		or not context.AutoDeleteKnown and "UNKNOWN_AUTO_DELETE_SETTINGS"
		or context.AutoDeleteActive and "NATIVE_AUTO_DELETE_ACTIVE"
		or capacity < 1 and "UNKNOWN_NATIVE_HATCH_CAPACITY"
		or not context.DigitalStorage and (not PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageCapacity) or not PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageUsed)) and "UNKNOWN_STORAGE_CAPACITY"
		or not context.DigitalStorage and free < 1 and "NO_FREE_PET_QUANTITY" or "AVAILABLE"
	if context.DigitalStorage then free = 1 end -- Native available-space check, never convert JSON bytes to pet slots.
	local batch = r.CapacityStatus == "AVAILABLE" and math.floor(math.min(h.MAXIMUM_BATCH_HATCHES, capacity, free, egg.Opened == false and 1 or math.huge)) or 0
	-- One first-test draw or authorized batch may be smaller than native capacity.
	if r.Spendable ~= nil then batch = math.min(batch, math.floor(r.Spendable / cost.Amount)) else batch = 0 end
	if config.PET_SETTINGS.AUTO_HATCH then
		batch = math.min(batch, h.MAXIMUM_SESSION_HATCHES, math.floor(h.MAXIMUM_SESSION_COST / cost.Amount))
	end
	r.EffectiveBatchCapacity = math.max(0, batch)
	if PetPolicy.Finite(egg.Duration) and egg.Duration > 0 and PetPolicy.Finite(context.MaxHatches) and context.MaxHatches >= 1 then
		r.EffectiveCycleSeconds = math.max(egg.Duration, h.MINIMUM_REQUEST_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
		-- Time efficiency describes one acquisition per cycle. Multiplying its team
		-- marginal by a batch overvalues duplicates once useful equip slots fill.
		r.ExpectedIncrementPerSecond = expected / r.EffectiveCycleSeconds
		r.TimeEfficiencyEvidence = "Single-draw native gain/cycle; excludes unknown travel, verification and server cadence"
		r.PotentialDrawsPerSecond = r.EffectiveBatchCapacity / r.EffectiveCycleSeconds
		if improveChance > 0 and r.EffectiveBatchCapacity >= 1 then
			local probability = 1 - (1 - improveChance) ^ r.EffectiveBatchCapacity
			if probability > 0 then
				r.ClientFirstUsefulBatchProbability = probability
				r.EstimatedSecondsToUsefulBasePet = r.EffectiveCycleSeconds / probability
				r.FirstUsefulTimeEvidence = "CONDITIONAL independent stationary client base draws; not measured time or verified server odds"
			end
		end
	end
	r.Reason = expected > 1e-6 and "Useful base-pet estimate against feasible OWNED-team benchmark; optimality/server odds UNKNOWN" or "NO_USEFUL_IMPROVEMENT against feasible owned-team benchmark"
	return r
end

methods.beforeMethodText:
function PetPolicy.EggBlocker(egg)
	if egg.Loaded ~= true then return "NOT_LOADED: actual native egg model required" end
	if not egg.Eligible then return egg.AccessStatus .. ": " .. tostring(egg.Reason) end
	if egg.Status ~= "ESTIMATE" then return "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: " .. tostring(egg.Reason) end
	if egg.BaselineIncomplete or egg.BaselineSearchBoundReached or (egg.BaselineProjectionFailures or 0) > 0 then
		return tostring(egg.BaselineStatus or "INCOMPLETE_OWNED_TEAM_BASELINE") .. ": incomplete search, unscored owned record/Super or native projection; no paid hatch before owned alternatives are evaluated"
	end
	if egg.ExpectedIncrement <= 1e-6 then return "NO_USEFUL_IMPROVEMENT in evaluated base-pet pool" end
	if egg.FundingStatus ~= "AFFORDABLE" then return egg.FundingStatus .. (egg.ReserveReason and ": " .. egg.ReserveReason or "") end
	if egg.SpendingStatus ~= "AUTHORIZED_CONFIG" then return egg.SpendingStatus end
	if egg.CapacityStatus ~= "AVAILABLE" or (egg.EffectiveBatchCapacity or 0) < 1 then return egg.CapacityStatus or "UNKNOWN_NATIVE_HATCH_CAPACITY" end
	if not PetPolicy.Finite(egg.DurationSeconds) or egg.DurationSeconds <= 0 then return "UNKNOWN_NATIVE_HATCH_DURATION" end
	return nil
end

function PetPolicy.EggBlocker(egg)
	if egg.Loaded ~= true then return "NOT_LOADED: actual native egg model required" end
	if not egg.Eligible then return egg.AccessStatus .. ": " .. tostring(egg.Reason) end
	if egg.Status ~= "ESTIMATE" then return "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: " .. tostring(egg.Reason) end
	if egg.BaselineIncomplete or egg.BaselineSearchBoundReached or (egg.BaselineProjectionFailures or 0) > 0 then
		return tostring(egg.BaselineStatus or "INCOMPLETE_OWNED_TEAM_BASELINE") .. ": incomplete search, unscored owned record/Super or native projection; no paid hatch before owned alternatives are evaluated"
	end
	if egg.OwnerCommonFunctionalTestRequested and not egg.OwnerCommonFunctionalTestEligible then
		return "OWNER_COMMON_FUNCTIONAL_TEST_SCOPE_BLOCKED: explicit account-bound isolated Common Egg / 10-Coin scope unavailable"
	end
	if egg.ExpectedIncrement <= 1e-6 and not egg.OwnerCommonFunctionalTestEligible then return "NO_USEFUL_IMPROVEMENT in evaluated base-pet pool" end
	if egg.FundingStatus ~= "AFFORDABLE" then return egg.FundingStatus .. (egg.ReserveReason and ": " .. egg.ReserveReason or "") end
	if egg.SpendingStatus ~= "AUTHORIZED_CONFIG" then return egg.SpendingStatus end
	if egg.CapacityStatus ~= "AVAILABLE" or (egg.EffectiveBatchCapacity or 0) < 1 then return egg.CapacityStatus or "UNKNOWN_NATIVE_HATCH_CAPACITY" end
	if not PetPolicy.Finite(egg.DurationSeconds) or egg.DurationSeconds <= 0 then return "UNKNOWN_NATIVE_HATCH_DURATION" end
	return nil
end

function OCBrain:PlanPets(report, context, state)
	local settings, hatch = self.Config.PET_SETTINGS, self.Config.HATCH_SETTINGS
	if not settings.ENABLE_PET_INTELLIGENCE or not self.Config.GENERAL_SETTINGS.ENABLE_RECOMMENDATIONS then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false } end
	if state.Pending then return { Kind = "OBSERVE", OwnsLocation = state.Location ~= nil, Reason = "Awaiting actual inventory/equipment acknowledgement" } end
	if state.Fault then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = state.Location ~= nil, Reason = state.Fault } end
	if state.EquipmentContinuation then return state.EquipmentContinuation end
	if state.Attempt and state.Attempt.Ended then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "One-time equipment authorization consumed: " .. tostring(state.Attempt.Status) } end
	if self.Config.PICKUP_SETTINGS.STATIONARY_ISOLATED_TEST then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "Pickup-only mode excludes pet actions" } end
	local team, inv = report.Team, context.Inventory
	if settings.EQUIP_OWNED_TEAM_ONCE then
		if state.Attempt then
			if state.Attempt.Ended then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "One-time owned-team attempt ended: " .. tostring(state.Attempt.Status) } end
			if not settings.AUTO_EQUIP then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "Equipment authorization withdrawn" } end
			return state.Attempt.Steps[state.Attempt.Step] or { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "No remaining equipment step" }
		end
		if not settings.AUTO_EQUIP or not inv or team.Status ~= "ESTIMATE" then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "One-time equipment requires ready native team analysis and authorization" } end
		if team.Gain <= 1e-6 then return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_END", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "No valid owned-team improvement; no equipment change" } end
		-- Freeze a complete serial plan BEFORE any command. Insufficient command budget,
		-- protected membership or a non-improving intermediate swap cannot leave a partial team.
		local projected = table.clone(context) projected.Inventory = table.clone(inv) projected.Inventory.Team = table.clone(inv.Team)
		local steps, commands = {}, state.EquipCommands
		while not PetPolicy.SameTeam(projected.Inventory.Team, team.ProposedIds) do
			local current = context.ScoreTeam(projected.Inventory.Team)
			if not PetPolicy.Finite(current) then return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_END", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "Native intermediate score UNKNOWN; no commands" } end
			local step = self:PlanEquipmentStep({ Status = "ESTIMATE", Gain = team.ProjectedScore - current, CurrentScore = current, ProposedIds = team.ProposedIds }, projected, { EquipCommands = commands })
			if not step then return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_END", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "Complete team plan blocked by command budget/protection or unsupported intermediate improvement; no commands" } end
			step.OwnsLocation = false table.insert(steps, step)
			commands += step.RemoveId and 2 or 1 projected.Inventory.Team = step.AfterIds
		end
		return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_START", OwnsLocation = false, Steps = steps, Team = team, RequiredCommands = commands - state.EquipCommands }
	end
	local equipment = self:PlanEquipmentStep(team, context, state)
	if state.HatchOnce then
		local reason = PetPolicy.HatchIsolation(self.Config)
		if reason then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = reason } end
	end
	if equipment then return equipment end
	if settings.AUTO_HATCH and not state.SessionEnded then
		local blockers = {}
		for _, egg in ipairs(report.Eggs) do
			if state.Location and PetPolicy.SelectionMode(self.Config) ~= "AUTO" and egg.Name ~= state.Location.EggName then continue end
			if not PetPolicy.EggSelected(self.Config, egg.Name) then continue end
			local blocker = PetPolicy.EggBlocker(egg)
			if blocker then table.insert(blockers, egg.Name .. ": " .. blocker) continue end
			if not PetPolicy.EggSelected(self.Config, egg.Name) or egg.Status ~= "ESTIMATE" or not egg.Eligible or not egg.Affordable
				or not egg.Cost or not table.find(hatch.ALLOWED_CURRENCIES, egg.Cost.Currency) or egg.Cost.Amount > hatch.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST
				or (egg.ExpectedIncrement <= 1e-6 and egg.ClientTargetProbability <= 0) then continue end
			local remainingCost = hatch.MAXIMUM_SESSION_COST - state.RequestCost
			local remaining = hatch.MAXIMUM_SESSION_HATCHES - state.RequestedHatches
			local free = PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageCapacity) and PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageUsed) and context.StorageCapacity - context.StorageUsed or 0
			if type(context.DigitalStorage) ~= "boolean" or context.InventoryFull ~= false or not context.AutoDeleteKnown or context.AutoDeleteActive then
				return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = state.Location ~= nil, Reason = context.AutoDeleteActive and "NATIVE_AUTO_DELETE_ACTIVE: disable native auto-delete manually before this test; OC will not change it"
					or not context.AutoDeleteKnown and "UNKNOWN_AUTO_DELETE_SETTINGS: no request" or "CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE_OR_FULL: native storage guard prevents hatch" }
			end
			if context.DigitalStorage then free = 1 end -- Bytes are not pet slots; use native available-space guard, one egg per request.
			local capacity = PetPolicy.Finite(context.MaxHatches) and context.MaxHatches or 0
			local count = math.floor(math.min(remaining, hatch.MAXIMUM_BATCH_HATCHES, capacity, free,
				egg.Spendable / egg.Cost.Amount, remainingCost / egg.Cost.Amount))
			if count < 1 or not PetPolicy.Finite(egg.DurationSeconds) or egg.DurationSeconds <= 0 then
				table.insert(blockers, egg.Name .. ": remaining request budget/capacity or native hatch duration unavailable") continue
			end
			local model
			for _, nativeEgg in ipairs(context.Eggs or {}) do if nativeEgg.Name == egg.Name then model = nativeEgg.Model break end end
			return { Kind = "HATCH", EggName = egg.Name, Model = model, Count = count, OwnsLocation = true,
				DecisionSource = "BRAIN", SelectionMode = PetPolicy.SelectionMode(self.Config), Currency = context.Currency,
				Reason = report.SelectionExplanation or (egg.InRange and "Authorized bounded useful hatch" or "Selected useful native egg requires controlled arrival or manual approach") }
		end
		return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false,
			Reason = #blockers > 0 and table.concat(blockers, "; ") or report.SelectionExplanation or "No useful eligible native egg; no fallback hatch" }
	end
	return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = state.Location ~= nil and not state.SessionEnded,
		Reason = state.SessionEnded and "Bounded hatch authorization ended; request ledger retained; no retry" or "Pet action authorization disabled" }
end

			if not PetPolicy.Finite(current) then return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_END", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "Native intermediate score UNKNOWN; no commands" } end
			local step = self:PlanEquipmentStep({ Status = "ESTIMATE", Gain = team.ProjectedScore - current, CurrentScore = current, ProposedIds = team.ProposedIds }, projected, { EquipCommands = commands })
			if not step then return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_END", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = "Complete team plan blocked by command budget/protection or unsupported intermediate improvement; no commands" } end
			step.OwnsLocation = false table.insert(steps, step)
			commands += step.RemoveId and 2 or 1 projected.Inventory.Team = step.AfterIds
		end
		return { Kind = "TEAM_ATTEMPT_START", OwnsLocation = false, Steps = steps, Team = team, RequiredCommands = commands - state.EquipCommands }
	end
	local equipment = self:PlanEquipmentStep(team, context, state)
	if state.HatchOnce then
		local reason = PetPolicy.HatchIsolation(self.Config)
		if reason then return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false, Reason = reason } end
	end
	if equipment then return equipment end
	if settings.AUTO_HATCH and not state.SessionEnded then
		local blockers = {}
		for _, egg in ipairs(report.Eggs) do
			if state.Location and PetPolicy.SelectionMode(self.Config) ~= "AUTO" and egg.Name ~= state.Location.EggName then continue end
			if not PetPolicy.EggSelected(self.Config, egg.Name) then continue end
			local blocker = PetPolicy.EggBlocker(egg)
			if blocker then table.insert(blockers, egg.Name .. ": " .. blocker) continue end
			if not PetPolicy.EggSelected(self.Config, egg.Name) or egg.Status ~= "ESTIMATE" or not egg.Eligible or not egg.Affordable
				or not egg.Cost or not table.find(hatch.ALLOWED_CURRENCIES, egg.Cost.Currency) or egg.Cost.Amount > hatch.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST
				or (egg.ExpectedIncrement <= 1e-6 and egg.ClientTargetProbability <= 0 and not egg.OwnerCommonFunctionalTestEligible) then continue end
			local remainingCost = hatch.MAXIMUM_SESSION_COST - state.RequestCost
			local remaining = hatch.MAXIMUM_SESSION_HATCHES - state.RequestedHatches
			local free = PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageCapacity) and PetPolicy.Finite(context.StorageUsed) and context.StorageCapacity - context.StorageUsed or 0
			if type(context.DigitalStorage) ~= "boolean" or context.InventoryFull ~= false or not context.AutoDeleteKnown or context.AutoDeleteActive then
				return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = state.Location ~= nil, Reason = context.AutoDeleteActive and "NATIVE_AUTO_DELETE_ACTIVE: disable native auto-delete manually before this test; OC will not change it"
					or not context.AutoDeleteKnown and "UNKNOWN_AUTO_DELETE_SETTINGS: no request" or "CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE_OR_FULL: native storage guard prevents hatch" }
			end
			if context.DigitalStorage then free = 1 end -- Bytes are not pet slots; use native available-space guard, one egg per request.
			local capacity = PetPolicy.Finite(context.MaxHatches) and context.MaxHatches or 0
			local count = math.floor(math.min(remaining, hatch.MAXIMUM_BATCH_HATCHES, capacity, free,
				egg.Spendable / egg.Cost.Amount, remainingCost / egg.Cost.Amount))
			if count < 1 or not PetPolicy.Finite(egg.DurationSeconds) or egg.DurationSeconds <= 0 then
				table.insert(blockers, egg.Name .. ": remaining request budget/capacity or native hatch duration unavailable") continue
			end
			local model
			for _, nativeEgg in ipairs(context.Eggs or {}) do if nativeEgg.Name == egg.Name then model = nativeEgg.Model break end end
			return { Kind = "HATCH", EggName = egg.Name, Model = model, Count = count, OwnsLocation = true,
				DecisionSource = "BRAIN", SelectionMode = PetPolicy.SelectionMode(self.Config), Currency = context.Currency,
				Reason = report.SelectionExplanation or (egg.InRange and "Authorized bounded useful hatch" or "Selected useful native egg requires controlled arrival or manual approach") }
		end
		return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = false,
			Reason = #blockers > 0 and table.concat(blockers, "; ") or report.SelectionExplanation or "No useful eligible native egg; no fallback hatch" }
	end
	return { Kind = "WAIT", OwnsLocation = state.Location ~= nil and not state.SessionEnded,
		Reason = state.SessionEnded and "Bounded hatch authorization ended; request ledger retained; no retry" or "Pet action authorization disabled" }
end

function PetPolicy.OwnerCommonEggFunctionalTestEligible(config, context, egg)
	local settings, h = config.OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_SETTINGS, config.HATCH_SETTINGS
	if not settings or settings.OWNER_ONE_COMMON_EGG_FUNCTIONAL_TEST ~= true
		or settings.OWNER_ONE_HATCH_TEST_ALLOWANCE ~= true then return false end
	local id = context and context.AccountId
	if not PetPolicy.Finite(id) or id <= 0 or id % 1 ~= 0 or id ~= settings.AUTHORIZED_ACCOUNT_ID then return false end
	if OwnerHatchTestAllowance.Isolation(config) then return false end
	for _, ceiling in ipairs({ settings.MAXIMUM_COIN_ALLOWANCE, settings.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST,
		h.MAXIMUM_EGG_COST, h.MAXIMUM_SESSION_COST }) do
		if not PetPolicy.Finite(ceiling) or ceiling <= 0 or ceiling > 10 then return false end
	end
	return egg.Name == "Common Egg" and egg.World == "The Overworld" and egg.Loaded == true and egg.Eligible == true
		and h.EGG_SELECTION_MODE == "MANUAL" and #h.SELECTED_EGGS == 1 and h.SELECTED_EGGS[1] == "Common Egg"
		and h.HATCH_ONE_EGG_ONCE == true and h.MAXIMUM_SESSION_HATCHES == 1 and h.MAXIMUM_BATCH_HATCHES == 1
		and egg.Cost and egg.Cost.Type == "Currency" and egg.Cost.Currency == "Coins"
		and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.Cost.Amount) and egg.Cost.Amount > 0 and egg.Cost.Amount <= 10
		and egg.OwnerTestAllowance and egg.OwnerTestAllowance.Eligible == true
		and egg.Status == "ESTIMATE" and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.ExpectedIncrement)
		and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.BaselineScore) and type(egg.BaselineIds) == "table"
		and egg.BaselineIncomplete == false and egg.BaselineSearchBoundReached == false and egg.BaselineProjectionFailures == 0
		and type(egg.Outcomes) == "table" and #egg.Outcomes > 0
		and egg.FundingStatus == "AFFORDABLE" and egg.SpendingStatus == "AUTHORIZED_CONFIG"
		and egg.CapacityStatus == "AVAILABLE" and egg.EffectiveBatchCapacity == 1
		and PetPolicy.Finite(egg.DurationSeconds) and egg.DurationSeconds > 0 or false
end
